create_array_record_data_source: create an ArrayRecordDataSource to read ArrayRecord files with dataset info and split configuration
build_dataset_random_access: build random access to ArrayRecord dataset records using __getitem__ with integer record keys
test_batch_record_retrieval: test batch retrieval of multiple records using __getitems__ with a sequence of record keys
iterate_array_record_dataset: iterate over all records in an ArrayRecordDataSource using __iter__ and __len__
deserialize_array_record_examples: deserialize ArrayRecord examples using dataset_info.features.deserialize_example_np with optional decoders
